Application Data.NAME: Green Valley Produce Market
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Valley Produce Market specializes in the sale of a wide variety of fresh fruits and vegetables sourced primarily from local farms and certified suppliers. Our operations include retailing produce directly to consumers, fostering relationships with local growers to ensure high-quality, seasonal offerings. We emphasize food safety and adhere to stringent quality control measures, sourcing from verified suppliers with established food safety certifications. Additionally, our market provides educational resources about healthy eating and sustainability practices to our customers, enhancing community engagement and promoting a farm-to-table philosophy. Our facilities are equipped with state-of-the-art refrigeration and storage systems to maintain optimal product freshness and quality for our clientele.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
Losses incurred during the past year include several incidents related to equipment failures and product spoilage: 

1. **Loss Date:** 05/15/2023 - **Cause:** Refrigeration unit breakdown due to electrical failure - **Amount:** $7,000 - **Status:** Paid and resolved. 

2. **Loss Date:** 06/20/2023 - **Cause:** Contamination of produce sourced from an unverified supplier - **Amount:** $5,000 - **Status:** Pending investigation, claim filed against supplier. 

Total Losses: $12,000.00.
